summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine PDMR shareholding notification. On 8 September 2026, the company granted a conditional award of 85,714 ordinary shares to Roanne Parry, Chief People Officer and Executive Committee member, under the GlaxoSmithKline 2017 Performance Share Plan at a reference price of 18.3750 per share, implying roughly 1.57 million in notional value. Vesting depends on performance measures over the three financial years from 1 January 2026 through 31 December 2028, with unvested elements lapsing and dividends accruing but vesting only to the extent awards vest. This is an ordinary executive compensation disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation apply. No risk-arb angle.
